brief.en: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
brief.zh: 快速击打身前或身后的敌人

description.en: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
description.zh: 菜问快速击打身前或身后的敌人。

chat.en: A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out of the price of one!
chat.zh: 菜问还是一位兼职牙医，这个月他还端上了一道“特色菜”————你能用拔掉一颗牙齿的价钱，让他给你敲掉两颗牙！

text.zh: 能击打身前和身后的敌人
